summary: Tested 'Merek Unggulan' (featured brands) on the backend and the UI at 390x844. Backend pytest 10/10 pass: GET /api/brands/featured gives the top 10 brands by product count, sorted, 'No Brand' left out, no _id. GET/PUT /api/admin/featured-brands returns 401 without a token and 403 for store_admin (jombang) and customer (demo). PUT {items:[ids]} keeps the order, drops unknown ids and removes duplicates. PUT {items:[]} makes the public list empty. PUT {items:null} and PUT {} both go back to automatic and delete the app_settings doc. A wrong type or more than 30 ids returns 422. UI: Beranda shows the featured-brands row after the free-shipping banner and flash sale and before the vouchers, with the initial or the logo (checked with a temporary logo on Vanstar). Tapping featured-brand-Vanstar opens /brand/Vanstar. /shop/pgs-jombang has no featured-brands. In Admin → Merek & Kategori → cm-tab-featured: the auto list shows with the 'Belum diatur' note and no cm-feat-auto button. cm-feat-up/down/remove, cm-feat-search and cm-feat-add-Suggo work, and the search leaves out brands already in the list and clears after adding. cm-feat-save shows 'Merek Unggulan disimpan', and the API order matches. After a reload Beranda shows the new order, and reopening the tab keeps the custom list (save disabled when nothing changed). Removing all brands and saving hides the row on Beranda. cm-feat-auto brings back the automatic top 10 on both admin and Beranda. Final state: automatic (no featured_brands doc), Vanstar logo back to '' (0 brands with a logo).

minor.issue: brand_counts() counts every product, whatever its status (nonaktif/draft included), so the automatic ranking can include products buyers cannot see. Brands with the same count have no tie-break, so their order can change between calls.

ui_bugs.issue: The row does not reload when you come back to Beranda. After saving in admin and pressing back (in-app navigation, no page reload), Beranda still showed the old order until a full reload or pull-to-refresh. FeaturedBrands only reloads when refreshKey changes.

issues: The cm-feat-up/down/remove buttons are 36x44, below the 44x44 minimum touch target (featured-brands-admin.tsx:91, styles.btn width 36).

action_items: (LOW) Reload FeaturedBrands when Beranda comes back into focus (for example, bump refreshKey in useFocusEffect, or have FeaturedBrands reload itself on focus), so an admin change shows without a reload.
(LOW) In brand_counts(), count only products with status 'active' for the automatic ranking, and add a tie-break by name.
(LOW) Make the admin up/down/remove buttons at least 44 wide.
critical_code_review_comments: Featured brands are stored by brand_id, so a brand rename keeps it in the list and a deleted brand is dropped quietly. Good.

In auto mode cm-feat-save is enabled even with no changes (dirty includes !custom). Saving then freezes the current auto list as a custom one. This matches the on-screen help text, but it may surprise admins.
seed_data_creation: None. Temporary changes during the test: featured list (custom order, then empty) and a Vanstar logo. Both were restored: featured set back to automatic with PUT items null (doc gone), Vanstar logo set back to ''.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the iter73 init script: grant geolocation, hide the location-lock ancestor that is a direct child of body, and set localStorage pgs_store_id=pgs-official and pgs_store_manual=1. Admin can log in by putting the token in localStorage 'pgs_auth_token'. Run pytest with -n0 and export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The automatic featured order is Vanstar, Apollystar, Q2 & GSF, UMKM, BMW, Club, Tabitha, Advance, HA, Kimplast. Vanstar brand_id is 78b94e09113d. Always finish with PUT /api/admin/featured-brands {items:null}.
